complete_compiler_story.summary: Hightouch tested whether a smaller model could flag incorrectly merged customer identities and send uncertain cases to Claude Opus for a second opinion. One reported threshold sent 22% of cases to Opus and reached 98.8% accuracy, compared with 99.0% for Opus alone. The results come from one vendor benchmark.
complete_compiler_story.why_it_matters: Data stewards can test the pattern on a labeled sample before changing a live merge process. Track incorrect merges and missed duplicates separately, and require human review for cases where an error would affect customers.

source.title: BMO Using Agentic AI to Help Credit Card Clients Get Faster Answers and Resolutions
source.scope: Reviewed the primary BMO announcement and companion case note covering eligibility, employee review and performance targets.
source.freshness_reason: The original publication date is retained and the source is evaluated under the normal fallback window.

read_evidence.scope: Reviewed the primary BMO announcement and companion case note covering eligibility, employee review and performance targets.

complete_compiler_story.summary: BMO introduced an internal assistant for employees handling Canadian credit card calls. It matches transactions, retrieves policy guidance and prepares eligible requests for review. BMO says these inquiries currently take 12 to 14 minutes on average and targets a 20% to 30% reduction for eligible calls. Those figures are goals.
complete_compiler_story.why_it_matters: Service teams can map which facts an assistant gathers and which decisions an employee owns. Pilot a single request type, record handling time and correction rates, and route policy exceptions through the existing review process.
complete_compiler_story.related_coverage: Reviewed the primary BMO announcement and companion case note covering eligibility, employee review and performance targets.

audience_fit.practical_action: Choose an eligible request type and map the information the assistant can collect.
audience_fit.review_action: Compare the draft decision with the source transaction and current policy.
audience_fit.usable_outcome: A reviewed service response with an escalation route for exceptions.

complete_compiler_story.headline: Salesforce makes renewal review a reusable Agentforce Skill

source.title: Salesforce’s Agentforce Coworker Usage Soars 21x in Three Months as Enterprises Delegate Real Work to AI
source.scope: Reviewed the Salesforce announcement and renewal example, Skill availability, permission context and planned scheduling.
source.freshness_reason: The original publication date is retained and the source is evaluated under the normal fallback window.

read_evidence.scope: Reviewed the Salesforce announcement and renewal example, Skill availability, permission context and planned scheduling.

complete_compiler_story.summary: Salesforce says Agentforce Coworker Skills can package a proven workflow as a request teammates can reuse. Its renewal example pulls service history, identifies unresolved cases and prepares a follow-up for review. The November announcement lists Skills as available and scheduled tasks as expected in December, which separates reuse from automatic execution.
complete_compiler_story.why_it_matters: Package one renewal review as a Skill with an account, a date range, and approved data sources. Ask for open issues and a draft, check the cited records, and have an account owner approve any outreach.
complete_compiler_story.related_coverage: Reviewed the Salesforce announcement and renewal example, Skill availability, permission context and planned scheduling.
complete_compiler_story.image_alt_intent: A renewal playbook uses account records to produce a cited issue list and draft at an approval gate.

audience_fit.intended_user: An account owner who reviews renewals using existing customer and support records.
audience_fit.practical_action: Run the same review for one account with an explicit date range and approved records.
audience_fit.review_action: Cross-check the case identifiers and have the responsible owner approve the follow-up.
audience_fit.usable_outcome: A cited list of unresolved cases and a draft follow-up ready for review.

complete_compiler_story.agent_skills_evidence: Use a reusable renewal review Skill. Supply one account and a review period. Retrieve approved service records, list open cases with identifiers, flag missing evidence and draft a follow-up. Return the draft and source list for the account owner to approve before outreach.
